title.en: A glass chip links two telescopes under real skies
title.zh: 一片玻璃芯片，把两台望远镜的星光接起来

summary.en: NSF’s November 19 update highlights CHARIOT’s two-beam photonic demonstration. Its 2024–25 sky tests show a useful engineering advance, with telescope infrastructure and faint-star limits still substantial.
summary.zh: NSF于11月19日介绍CHARIOT双光束光子芯片示范。2024至2025年的观测体现工程进展，望远镜基础设施与暗星精度仍有明确边界。

title.en: Europe’s smaller budget proposal carries larger research ambitions
title.zh: 欧盟预算提案缩小，科研承诺为何仍扩大

summary.en: António Costa’s November 21 proposal lowers the Commission’s 2028–34 total by about 10%, while Horizon Europe rises against the current programme. Different baselines and proposed revenues frame a negotiation that remains unfinished.
summary.zh: 安东尼奥·科斯塔11月21日提案较欧委会2028至2034年方案缩减约10%，Horizon Europe仍较现行项目增长。比较基准、拟议收入与未完成的法律程序决定了数字的含义。
